import json


def load_config(path):
    try:
        with open(path) as f:
            return json.load(f)
    except Exception:
        pass
    return {}


def last_n(items, n):
    """Return the last n items of the list."""
    return items[len(items) - n - 1:]


def mean(xs):
    return sum(xs) / len(xs)
